item.title: Elevance Raises Full-Year Guidance on Lower Medical Costs
item.description: Elevance Health Inc. raised its full-year profit guidance after a better-than-expected third quarter and signaled earnings next year would top current Wall Street estimates, a sign of growing confidence as the healthcare giant rebuilds profits in its insurance business.

item.title: Russia Sees First Diesel Cargo Sailing for US on Thursday
item.description: A tanker loaded with Russian diesel will sail for the US on Thursday as Moscow starts to implement a fuel supply deal struck by Vladimir Putin and Donald Trump, according to Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak.

item.title: Oppenheimer’s Stoltzfus Sees ‘Broader Rally’ in Stocks to Year End
item.description: John Stoltzfus, chief investment strategist at Oppenheimer, says traders have been carrying the equity market for the last month or so and expects “improved breadth in the market as we go forward.” He speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Stocks Rebound on Strong SpaceX Results; AI Bubble Dispute; Tech Earnings on Deck
item.description: US equity futures rise as SpaceX's quarterly earnings and Elon Musk's remarks on a potential SpaceX-Tesla merger boost investor confidence. Citadel's Ken Griffin warns that investors are "almost certainly" in an AI bubble, while Deutsche Bank's Christian Sewing says he doesn't see one. Jensen Huang speaks at the Nvidia GTC event in Berlin. Tesla, Meta, and IBM are set to report earnings. Kallum Pickering of Peel Hunt joins "Bloomberg Brief" on the risks around debt-financed growth. Bernard Mensah, President of Bank of America International joins Bloomberg's Francine Lacqua for an exclusive conversation at the Berlin Global Dialogue. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: BlackRock See ‘Generational High Yields’ in Corporate Credit
item.description: BlackRock Inc. says current corporate bond yields offer a more resilient source of returns that doesn’t depend on expectations for falling interest rates or tighter spreads.
